Northbridge Borough Council
Performance and Insight Officer
Grade: SO2 (£37,248 to £39,729 per annum)
Location: Civic Centre, Northbridge (hybrid working)
Contract: Permanent, 36 hours a week
Reference: NBC-PI-2026-044
Closing date: 30 October 2026 at midnight

About the role
Our Performance and Insight team helps services understand how they are doing and where to improve. You will build performance reports for adult social care, housing and waste services, analyse data to answer questions from managers and councillors, and help keep our data accurate and secure.

Our values
Respect, Ownership, Collaboration and Ambition for Northbridge.

Person specification
Each criterion shows how it will be assessed: A = application form, I = interview, T = test.

Essential
1. Educated to degree level or equivalent experience in a data or analytical role (A)
2. Experience of writing SQL queries to extract and combine data (A, T)
3. Experience of producing clear reports and dashboards for managers (A, I)
4. Knowledge of UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018 when handling personal data (A)
5. Ability to present findings confidently to senior managers and councillors (I)

Desirable
6. Experience of Power BI (A)
7. Experience of working in local government (A)

How to apply
Apply online through our jobs portal. Instead of a supporting statement, please answer these questions:
Question 1: Tell us about a time you used data to help improve a service. What did you do and what was the result? (maximum 250 words)
Question 2: How have you made sure personal data is handled safely and lawfully in your work? (maximum 200 words)

This post is not politically restricted. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.
